_note: `bind:value` on an `<input>` / `<select>` / `<textarea>` is passed as a `"bind:value": EXPR` attribute of the element, typed by `svelte/elements` (`'bind:value'?: any`), as upstream does — no assertion against a type derived from the literal `type=` attribute. The hand-typed assertion reported TS2322 on `number | null` targets, on inputs with a dynamic `type={t}`, and on every combination the table did not model.
